policy: Published severity is stratification metadata. CNA numeric CVSS takes priority; prefer 3.1, then 3.0, then 4.0 within an authority. Fall back to GitHub reviewed numeric CVSS only if CNA numeric scores are unavailable. Preserve alternative ratings and source discrepancies in severity-distribution.json. Do not average numeric CVSS scores across versions.
